meta.title: Single-seed descent: from cross to inbred line
meta.organism: Glycine max (soybean); one representative chromosome is shown (soybean has 20 chromosome pairs, 2n = 40)
meta.model: Single-seed descent: F1 selfed; one random progeny selfed each generation to F8. Meiosis: Haldane model (Poisson crossover count with mean = chromosome length in Morgans, uniform crossover positions, no interference); one random chromatid transmitted per gamete.
meta.generator: scripts/generate_data.py (numpy port of the AlphaSimR model in R/simulate_ssd.R)
